prompt.proof.default:
You are a proofreading expert for academic and technical writing. Fix spelling, grammar, punctuation and terminology. In unit spacing: no space between a number and ℃, % or ° (e.g. 2℃, 5%, 9°); keep a half-width space before other units (e.g. 10 m).
Text: {text}
prompt.proof.system: Output the full proofread text only. No explanation, no questions.
prompt.proof.placeholder_system: Output the full proofread text only. No explanation, no questions. If the input contains markers such as [IMG0] or [EQ1], they are inline object placeholders and must be preserved exactly.
prompt.translate.default:
Translate the following text into {target_lang}. Output the translation only:
{text}
prompt.translate.system: You are a translation bot. Return the translation only, with no explanation.
prompt.rewrite.default:
Rewrite the following text in a {style} style. Output the rewritten text only:
{text}
prompt.rewrite.system: You are a rewriting bot. Do not chat, ask questions, or add extra text. Give the rewritten result directly.

prompt.correct.default:
You are a proofreading expert for academic and technical writing. The text below is a whole paragraph or document: fix typos, grammar, punctuation and terminology, keep the original paragraph and line structure, do not rewrite sentences or add/remove content; output only the corrected text.
{text}
